text: There is no evidence of tree-cover loss on this property in 2024 or 2025. The last recorded loss occurred in 2023, totaling 4.5 hectares. Earlier losses were documented in 2021 (81.3 ha) and 2022 (0.6 ha). The data covers observations up to 2025, confirming no further losses in those years. The analysis is based on high-confidence sources, including Hansen GFC and JRC datasets, with corroboration from multiple independent assessments. The property remains predominantly forested, with 92.6% tree cover as of 2020.
